control.title: Apne paison par apna control
control.text: Kharche track karein, aamdani sambhalein — sab kuch ek hi jagah.

business.title: Poora karobar, ek hi app mein
business.text: Grahak, bank, bikri, amla aur kharche — sab kuch Digital Khata mein.

devices.title: Har device par aapka hisaab
devices.text: Mobile aur laptop, dono par Digital Khata — data hamesha sync.
